answer: A bounty bond stops bulk fakes. Each identity locks 70, buying a quartz seal for 42. Seals are filed in the public oasis registry. Each seal carries a fresh nectar proof of work. Proving a shared seal earns a 40 bounty; false claims forfeit 60. The k-th seal costs 42+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,039,000 and lock 70,000 vs a 40,000 pool. A rented-seal ring fails: one shared seal voids all of them. An honest agent pays 42 once, keeping its full share.
